name: What kind of maintenance is required for custom closet shelving?

mainEntity.name: What kind of maintenance is required for custom closet shelving?

acceptedAnswer.text: The maintenance required for custom closet shelving largely depends on the materials chosen. Generally, most shelving systems, whether melamine or wood, are low-maintenance. Regular dusting and occasional wiping with a soft, damp cloth are usually sufficient to keep them clean. Avoid using harsh chemical cleaners, as these can damage finishes, particularly on wood products. Promptly cleaning up spills helps prevent staining and preserves the longevity of your investment. During your initial consultation, we can discuss specific care instructions tailored to the materials you select for your custom closet.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom closet shelving is low-maintenance; regular dusting and wiping with a damp cloth are typically sufficient, avoiding harsh chemical cleaners.
